purpose: Incremental official-source evidence for the existing full affiliate audit. Evidence only; this does not create a new queue task, UUID, or duplicate application. The current main-branch registry and latest queue state were checked first. Fireflies.ai, which follows Omi AI in the registry, already has the completed dedicated task apply-fireflies-ai and was therefore skipped. None of the five entries below has a dedicated application task in latest.json.
source_priority: Current first-party vendor pages and current partner-platform listings were preferred over older first-party marketing posts when terms conflicted.

entries.commission: 25% of the referred customer's first-year revenue on the current PartnerStack Gamma program listing
entries.eligibility: Gamma's current help center says creators, founders, educators, community builders, and anyone with an audience may apply; applications are reviewed and most are decided within 5-10 business days.
entries.legal_consent_note: Gamma's partner terms state that applying constitutes agreement to legally binding partner terms. No application was submitted in this audit pass; if an application flow reaches a forced legal-consent step later, human approval is required before submission.
entries.evidence_summary: Gamma's current help center confirms a live affiliate program managed in PartnerStack. The current PartnerStack program listing shows a 25% first-year offer, while Gamma's current program terms specify a 60-day cookie and monthly PartnerStack payments. Older PartnerStack directory snapshots showing 30% were not used as the current rate.

entries.commission: 20% recurring commission on all referred-customer payments for the first 12 months after the initial purchase
entries.payout_terms: Commissions become payable after 30 days; minimum payout $75; PayPal payout
entries.eligibility: Gobii's official site footer exposes the Affiliate Program link, and the linked Rewardful signup page is titled Gobii Affiliates 2026.
entries.evidence_summary: Gobii's current official site links directly to its live Rewardful affiliate signup. The current signup page confirms 20% recurring commission for up to 12 months, a 30-day commission delay, $75 payout minimum, and PayPal payouts.

entries.commission: 25% recurring on every subscription payment; 25% one-time on lifetime-plan purchases
entries.payout_terms: NET30; minimum payout $50; no earnings cap
entries.eligibility: Applications are manually reviewed by the founder; the official page asks applicants to describe their channel, audience, and fit.
entries.evidence_summary: Voibe's current official affiliate page, published March 30, 2026, confirms a live Lemon Squeezy program with 25% recurring commission, 30-day cookie, $50 minimum payout, NET30 terms, no earnings cap, and manual founder approval.

entries.commission: 30% recurring on monthly-plan payments for up to 12 months; 30% one-time on annual-plan purchases; headline states up to $67 per sale
entries.payout_terms: Paid around the first working week of each month; minimum payout $100
entries.eligibility: The official page states a paid Merlin subscription is not required to participate. Minimum qualifying order value is $14 for monthly subscriptions and $100 for annual subscriptions unless a special affiliate offer overrides it.
entries.domain_identity_note: The registry currently lists merlin.ai, while the current affiliate page is hosted on getmerlin.in. Merlin's current first-party privacy policy identifies Foyer Technologies/Foyer Tech as the operator of Merlin AI and lists getmerlin.in among its service websites, supporting first-party identity for this audit evidence.
entries.evidence_summary: Merlin's current first-party affiliate page confirms a live Tapfiliate program with 30% commission, monthly-plan recurring earnings for up to 12 months, 90-day cookies, monthly payouts, a $100 minimum payout, and no paid-subscription requirement for affiliates.

entries.commission: Current affiliate landing page says 30% of every referred sale; an older current-domain marketing article says 40% of qualifying sales
entries.eligibility: Current application form requests first name, last name, work email, website, and monthly website visitor count.
entries.conflict_note: Speechify's current affiliate landing page says 30% commission and 30-day cookies, while its FAQ on the same page says a paid purchase within 60 days can qualify. A first-party article published earlier in 2026 says 40% commission, 30-day tracking, and up to 90 days to purchase. Because first-party terms conflict, the exact current rate and attribution window must be verified in the application/partner terms before submission.
entries.legal_consent_note: The current application form states that submitting acknowledges and accepts Speechify's Privacy Policy. No form was submitted in this audit pass; a forced legal-consent step later requires human approval.
entries.evidence_summary: Speechify clearly operates a current affiliate program, but current first-party materials conflict on commission and attribution timing. It remains needs_manual_verification rather than being auto-queued for application until the live application terms resolve the conflict.
